description: This file defines a module for generating PowerPoint presentations programmatically. It includes functions for converting files and URLs to data URLs, applying transformations to values, resolving template placeholders, and rendering slides with images, text, and shapes based on template models and user data. The main exported function is generatePptx, which constructs a PPTX presentation using the 'pptxgenjs' library, incorporating layout, background, shapes, images, and text as specified by the input data.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be a data URL by verifying if it starts with 'data:'.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File object or string URL into a data URL, possibly reading files or fetching URLs asynchronously.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches a URL and converts the response blob into a data URL.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specified transformations like bulletsToLines, formatPercent, or formatCurrency to input values.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Determines the presentation title from globalFirst data or defaults to 'presentation'.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates a name string to produce a valid filename for the presentation.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Resolves a specific data value based on the current slide step and data scope.

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts points to inches for use with pptxgenjs layout units.

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, placeholderId, value)
methods.description: Adds a text placeholder to a slide if no other content is available.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, placeholderId, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Adds an image placeholder or a message if image data cannot be loaded.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Renders fixed (layout/master) shapes like rectangles or images specified in the template layout.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main exported function that generates a PPTX file using provided template models, slide order, and user data, returning a Blob and filename.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
